title: Affliction of the Hebrew Laborers
image_prompt: Mud-brick brickyards along the Nile: Hebrew laborers in modest, full-length ancient working tunics carrying wooden yokes of clay bricks and straw under harsh Egyptian overseers, with towering sandstone pyramids and treasure cities Pithom and Raamses rising in the dusty haze.

title: Faith of the Hebrew Midwives
image_prompt: Ancient Goshen dwelling at twilight: godly Hebrew midwives Shiphrah and Puah, draped in modest linen veils and robes, kneeling with heads lifted in reverent prayer, sheltering newborn Hebrew babies in secret out of holy fear of God.

title: The Ark of Bulrushes
image_prompt: Quiet misty dawn among the tall papyrus reeds of the River Nile: tearful mother Jochebed and young sister Miriam, modestly cloaked, gently placing a woven wicker basket coated with pitch containing infant Moses into the calm river waters.

title: Pharaoh's Daughter Finds the Child
image_prompt: Lush royal riverbank: Pharaoh's daughter, dressed in an elegant, modest full-length pleated white linen royal gown and gold circlet, smiling with tender compassion as her maiden lifts weeping baby Moses from the reed basket, while young Miriam watches hopefully from the reeds.

title: Moses Defends His Brethren
image_prompt: Solitary desert quarry outside the city: young adult Moses in noble travel tunics stepping in with righteous indignation between an Egyptian taskmaster and an exhausted Hebrew worker, casting dramatic shadows against sunlit sandstone.

title: Moses at the Well of Midian
image_prompt: Rocky desert oasis in Midian at sunset: Moses, wearing a simple shepherd's mantle and leaning on a staff, driving off rowdy shepherds from the stone watering well and gently drawing clear bucket water for the seven shepherdess daughters of Reuel and their sheep.

title: The Burning Bush on Mount Horeb
image_prompt: Rugged, sacred granite slopes of Mount Horeb: solitary 80-year-old shepherd Moses kneeling in awe, taking his leather sandals off his bare feet before a rugged desert acacia bush ablaze with brilliant, supernatural golden fire that burns without consuming the leaves.

title: The Revelation of I AM THAT I AM
image_prompt: High mountain summit enveloped in radiant divine light: Moses shielding his eyes with trembling, reverent hands as a heavenly beam breaks through the clouds, revealing the sacred promise of deliverance for the children of Israel.

title: The Miraculous Signs of the Rod
image_prompt: Rocky plateau of Horeb: Moses recoiling in surprise as his wooden shepherd's staff on the ground transforms into a living coiled serpent, before reaching out by faith to seize it by the tail; golden supernatural aura.

title: Moses and Aaron Meet the Elders
image_prompt: Ancient mud-brick assembly room in Goshen: mature bearded brothers Moses and Aaron meeting the elders of Israel, Aaron speaking with passion while elders bow their heads in tears of worship upon hearing God has visited them.

title: Before Pharaoh: Let My People Go
image_prompt: Massive imperial Egyptian throne room: Moses and Aaron holding the wooden rod, standing resolute and fearless before the hardened Pharaoh seated on his raised golden throne, surrounded by royal fan-bearers and palace guards.

title: Bricks Without Straw
image_prompt: Scorching desert field: Hebrew laborers in modest tunics desperately scouring dry stubble across barren fields to fulfill impossible brick quotas under the watchful eyes of Egyptian taskmasters with whips.

title: The Covenant by the Outstretched Arm
image_prompt: Solitary hilltop at dusk: Moses in deep prayer, illuminated by a comforting beam of heavenly golden light from above as God reaffirms the covenant made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob to redeem Israel with an outstretched arm.

title: Aaron's Rod Swallows the Serpents
image_prompt: Pharaoh's council chamber: Aaron's large living serpent striking forward and swallowing whole the serpents summoned by Egyptian sorcerers and magicians, while Pharaoh looks on with a cold, stubborn sneer.

title: Plague One: Waters Turned to Blood
image_prompt: Banks of the great River Nile: Aaron stretching out the wooden rod over the river, the vast blue waters instantly transforming into deep crimson blood across canals, reservoirs, and stone basins throughout Egypt.

title: Plague Two: Swarms of Frogs
image_prompt: Egyptian palace corridors and courtyards overwhelmed by countless green frogs leaping onto royal daybeds, kitchen kneading bowls, and stone steps, as Pharaoh shields his robes in frustration and distress.

title: Plague Three: The Dust Becomes Lice
image_prompt: Aaron striking the dry desert soil with his rod, clouds of dust transforming into dense swarms of lice upon men and beasts; bewildered Egyptian magicians raising hands in defeat, declaring 'This is the finger of God'.

title: Plague Four: Grievous Swarms of Flies
image_prompt: Dramatic split composition: Egyptian palaces enveloped in dark, buzzing clouds of flies corrupting the land, contrasted with the peaceful green valley of Goshen in bright sunshine where not a single fly is found.

title: Plague Five: Pestilence on the Livestock
image_prompt: Egyptian pastures under gloomy skies: royal cattle, horses, and camels collapsed from murrain sickness, while across the border in Goshen, Hebrew sheep and oxen graze healthy and unharmed in green fields.

title: Plague Six: Boils from the Furnace Ashes
image_prompt: Before the palace steps: Moses scattering handfuls of black soot and furnace ash into the sky; fine dust spreading as Egyptian magicians and soldiers clutch their arms and faces in pain from painful blistering boils.

title: Plague Seven: Thunder, Hail, and Fire
image_prompt: Apocalyptic storm over Egypt: colossal blocks of icy hail mingled with terrifying streams of lightning and fire falling directly to the ground, shattering trees and crops, while serene Goshen remains untouched beneath peaceful skies.

title: Plague Eight: Dense Swarms of Locusts
image_prompt: Strong east wind blowing a colossal black cloud of millions of locusts darkening the midday sun, descending across Egyptian fields, stripping every green leaf, fruit tree, and crop bare to the bark.

title: Plague Nine: Thick Darkness That May Be Felt
image_prompt: Atmospheric contrast: Egypt smothered in an impenetrable, suffocating pitch-black darkness where people cannot see each other or move, while distant Goshen shines with radiant, serene holy light from every Hebrew dwelling.
